title: The Little Pink Lace Secrets
subtitle: Ankita — Morning to Cyber City Office, with parallel society parcel chain
continuityNote: Latest EP02 clock controls scene timing. Previous EP01 draft includes contradictory same-day 06:45 morning beat; requires reconciliation. Vivan/Ankita earlier mild curiosity remains an established prologue proposal, not an approved relationship.
parcelNote: The original six-set ownership, sequence and hidden-knowledge plot lives in episode-02-ankita-plan.json. This prose uses non-graphic references to each unauthorized removal and is NOT a rewrite of any separately planned explicit fantasy. The graphic portions are not authored here.
contentPolicy: Non-graphic adult relational drama. No minors sexualized. Unauthorized conduct is not consent.

parts.title: The First Greeting
parts.body:
Ankita ke phone ka alarm baja. Usse pehle ki woh screen tak pahunchti, Kabir ne phone apne haath mein utha liya.

Ankita: "Kabir, alarm band karna tha. Phone kidnap nahi."
Kabir: "Good morning, Mrs. Malhotra. Happy New Year."
Ankita: "Happy New Year, Mr. Malhotra. Ab mera phone wapas?"
Kabir: "Ek smile ke badle."
Ankita: "Itni subah negotiation?"
Kabir: "New Year hai. Naye rules."

Ankita ne takiye se sir uthaya aur muskurate hue haath badhaya.

Ankita: "Achha. Smile mil gayi. Ab agreement fulfill karo."
Kabir: "Aaj bhi production release?"
Ankita: "Haan. Lekin pehle morning walk."
Kabir: "Tumhari company ko pata hai tum insaan ho?"
Ankita: "Pata hai. Isliye sirf half-day support rakha hai."
Kabir: "Aur mere New Year plans?"
Ankita: "Tum breakfast bana rahe ho. Wahi sabse bada plan hai."
Kabir: "Aur agar main breakfast perfect bana doon?"
Ankita: "Toh main tumhe officially best husband declare kar dungi."
Kabir: "Unofficially?"
Ankita: "Us category mein competition hi nahi hai."

Kabir hans pada. Usne Ankita ka haath pakadkar apni taraf kheencha. Woh kuch pal uske paas ruki aur usse hug kiya.

Kabir: "You know, I really like this version of you."
Ankita: "Kaunsa version?"
Kabir: "Jo subah uthte hi mujhe orders dena shuru kar deti hai."
Ankita: "Toh tumhe meri manager personality pasand hai?"
Kabir: "Manager nahi. Meri wife."

Ankita ne uske kandhe par halki thapki di.

Ankita: "Good answer. Ab kitchen mein prove karna."

06:18 par woh apni athletic jacket pehenkar bedroom se nikli. Kabir ne kitchen ki taraf jaane se pehle usse ek baar phir Happy New Year kaha.

parts.title: The Morning Walk
parts.body:
Walking track comparatively khaali tha. Ankita ne fitted athletic jacket ki zip adjust ki, ponytail tight ki aur brisk walking shuru kar di. Do rounds ke baad familiar awaaz sunai di.

Rohan (34, Shivani ka husband): "Happy New Year, Ankita ji! Aaj bhi attendance laga di?"
Ankita: "Good morning, Rohan. Kuch log resolutions sirf WhatsApp status pe nahi likhte."
Rohan: "Aap seedha personal attack kar rahi hain."
Ankita: "Aapne khud baat shuru ki."

Rohan uske saath pace match karne laga.

Rohan: "Waise ek baat bolun?"
Ankita: "Depends. Compliment hai ya complaint?"
Rohan: "Compliment."
Ankita: "Toh permission granted."
Rohan: "Office, ghar, fitness. Aap itna sab manage kaise kar leti hain? Main toh ek week regular walking kar loon toh khud ko medal dene lagta hoon."
Ankita: "Simple. Medal lena band karo, walking continue karo."
Rohan: "Shivani bhi yahi bolti hai."
Ankita: "Smart woman."
Rohan: "Main keh raha tha aap smart hain, aur aap meri wife ki tareef kar rahi hain."
Ankita: "Credit jahan due ho, wahan dena chahiye."

Rohan hans diya. Nikhil apni run ke baad cooling down kar raha tha.

Nikhil (35, Meenakshi ka husband): "Kis baat pe itni hasi aa rahi hai?"
Rohan: "Ankita ji ne mujhe fitness lecture de diya."
Ankita: "Lecture nahi. Free consultation."
Nikhil: "Free? Rohan, lucky ho. Meenakshi toh mere health advice ignore karne ka bhi record rakhti hai."
Ankita: "Doctor ki advice ignore karoge toh record toh banega."
Nikhil: "Aap dono team bana chuke ho kya?"
Rohan: "Lag toh raha hai."

Nikhil ne Ankita ke saath kuch kadam chale.

Nikhil: "Your consistency is genuinely impressive. Last week bhi aap daily aa rahi thi."
Ankita: "Notice kar rahe the?"
Nikhil: "Running track chhota hai. Regular log automatically notice ho jaate hain."
Ankita: "Good recovery."
Rohan: "Nikhil, tum bhi interrogation mein phans gaye."
Ankita: "Main bas simple questions pooch rahi hoon."
Rohan: "Aur hum dono jawab dene se pehle soch rahe hain."
Ankita: "Excellent. Ab next lap."

Rohan ko Ankita ki wit aur energy attractive lagti thi; Nikhil uske discipline se impressed tha. Ankita ne dono ki baat ko friendly neighbourly banter hi maana.

06:37 par track junction aa gaya.

Rohan: "Tomorrow same time?"
Ankita: "Aap dono aaye toh main attendance laga dungi."
Nikhil: "Ab toh aana padega."
Ankita: "Good. New Year resolutions officially monitored."

parts.title: Posture and Permission
parts.body:
Trainer Vivek Rao (30) ne mats ke paas stretching bands arrange kar rakhe the.

Vivek: "Morning, Ankita. Happy New Year."
Ankita: "Happy New Year. Aaj easy session hai na?"
Vivek: "Aapne easy session kab accept kiya hai?"
Ankita: "Main toh har baar karti hoon. Aap exercises badha dete ho."
Vivek: "Aap last rep par bhi bolti ho, 'One more.'"
Ankita: "Professional habit. Last issue close kiye bina chain nahi milta."

Vivek ne shoulder mobility demonstrate ki.

Vivek: "Left shoulder relaxed. Elbow thoda bahar hai. Alignment dikha doon?"
Ankita: "Haan, dikhao. Phir main adjust kar lungi."

Vivek ne permission ke baad uske forearm ki position briefly correct ki, phir khud movement demonstrate ki.

Vivek: "Exactly. Ab better."
Ankita: "See? Instructions clear hon toh execution perfect hota hai."
Vivek: "Aapko workout class conduct karni chahiye."
Ankita: "Fees kitni doge?"
Vivek: "Aap toh serious ho gayi."
Ankita: "Business opportunity miss nahi karni chahiye."

Vikram (36, Shreya ka husband) cooldown ke liye aaya.

Vikram: "New Year aur yahan already corporate negotiation chal rahi hai?"
Ankita: "Vivek mujhe job offer kar raha hai."
Vivek: "Main sirf keh raha tha, she's extremely disciplined."
Vikram: "Meri wife bhi aaj training pe aa rahi hai. Aap logon ki competition tough hogi."
Ankita: "Shreya police fitness karti hai. Main usse compete nahi karungi."
Vikram: "Woh bhi yehi kahegi, phir race shuru kar degi."

Ankita hansi.

Vivek: "Last stretch. Then done."
Ankita: "Perfect. Mujhe office ke liye ready bhi hona hai."

Vivek uski confident, playful energy notice karta tha, lekin session professionally end hua.

parts.title: Two Brothers, Two Ways of Noticing
parts.body:
Ankita fresh hokar dining area mein pahunchi. Kabir kitchen mein tha. Karan aur Aman table par baithe the; Rajeev newspaper padh rahe the.

Karan (22, Kabir ka younger twin brother): "Good morning, Bhabhi!"
Ankita: "Good morning. Tum dono itni subah?"
Karan: "Aapne New Year resolutions ka pressure bana diya."
Ankita: "Maine?"
Karan: "Aap subah running, phir office. Hum dono ko sharam aa rahi thi."
Aman (22, Karan ka twin): "Mujhe nahi. Main Java ke questions revise kar raha tha."
Karan: "Ek bhai fitness se bhaag raha hai aur doosra social life se."
Aman: "Tum MBA preparation se bhaag rahe ho."
Ankita: "Excellent. Dono ke excuses ready hain."
Karan: "Waise Bhabhi, aaj toh aap full energetic lag rahi ho. New Year ka effect hai?"
Ankita: "Nahi. Time pe uthne ka effect hai."
Karan: "Kabhi-kabhi lagta hai aap hum dono se zyada young ho."
Ankita: "Kabhi-kabhi? Mujhe toh roz lagta hai."

Kabir breakfast plate lekar aaya.

Kabir: "Tum dono meri wife ko compliment kar rahe ho ya fitness membership bech rahe ho?"
Karan: "Compliment, Bhai. Genuine wala."
Ankita: "Kabir, tum jealous ho?"
Kabir: "Nahi. Bas compliments ka standard maintain karna hai."
Karan: "Bhai, aapko competition pasand nahi?"
Kabir: "Breakfast pe focus karo, champion."

Aman ne apna phone rakha.

Aman: "Bhabhi, ek serious baat. Mujhe Java backend interview ka call aaya hai."
Ankita: "Nice! Spring Boot, REST API, database aur concurrency revise kiya?"
Aman: "REST aur Spring Boot ho gaya. Concurrency mein doubt hai."
Karan: "Ye poori raat notes banata hai."
Ankita: "Tum chup raho. Aman, shaam ko questions bhej dena. Main review kar dungi."
Aman: "Thanks, Bhabhi."
Rajeev (61, Kabir ke father): "Aman, raat bhar jagkar mat padhna. Health bhi zaroori hai."
Ankita: "Papa sahi keh rahe hain."
Karan: "Papa ko bhi Bhabhi ki team mein le liya."
Rajeev: "Main toh hamesha disciplined logon ki team mein hoon."

Ankita ne breakfast taste kiya.

Ankita: "Not bad, Mr. Malhotra."
Kabir: "Not bad? Maine best husband award expect kiya tha."
Ankita: "Final verdict dinner ke baad."

Karan ko bhabhi ke saath teasing pasand thi; kabhi uski attention ek extra moment tak tikti aur woh apni inappropriate thoughts se bachne ki koshish karta. Aman interview notes mein laut gaya. Rajeev ne apna newspaper wapas utha liya; uski concealed interest Ankita ko maloom nahi thi.

parts.title: The Cream Kurti and the Last Look
parts.body:
Ankita mirror ke saamne khadi thi. Cream embroidered kurti, tailored beige blazer, fitted trousers, simple earrings, khule wavy hair aur laptop bag—holiday deployment ke liye uska office look ready tha.

Kabir: "Excuse me, ma'am. Appointment milegi?"
Ankita: "Walk-in consultation allowed hai."
Kabir: "I have a complaint."
Ankita: "Kya?"
Kabir: "Aapne mujhe bataya hi nahi ki aaj itna impressive office look plan kiya hai."
Ankita: "Main office ja rahi hoon. Fashion show nahi."
Kabir: "Office wale fortunate hain."
Ankita: "Aaj bahut compliments ho rahe hain."
Kabir: "New Year discount chal raha hai."
Ankita: "Discount? Toh kal se band?"
Kabir: "Tumhare liye lifetime membership."

Kabir ne uske blazer collar ko seedha kiya.

Kabir: "There. Perfect."
Ankita: "Thank you."

Ankita ne Kabir ke gaal par quick kiss di aur bag utha liya. Corridor mein Rajeev khade the.

Rajeev: "Beta, cab time par aa jayegi?"
Ankita: "Haan Papa. Eight five departure hai."
Rajeev: "New Year pe bhi kaam?"
Ankita: "Production deployment hai. Bas zaroori team ja rahi hai."
Rajeev: "Achha. Dhyan se jaana."
Ankita: "Ji, Papa."

Rajeev ke andar attraction aur household-elder ki responsibility ke beech ek uncomfortable contradiction tha. Ankita ne unki concern ko ordinary family care samjha.

parts.title: Two Faces in the Lift
parts.body:
Lift fourth floor par ruki. Ayaan aur Armaan community-week posters ke rolls lekar andar aaye.

Ayaan: "Good morning, Ankita di! Happy New Year."
Ankita: "Happy New Year, Ayaan. Posters ready?"
Armaan: "Almost. QR code kal raat update kiya."
Ankita: "Almost ka matlab?"
Ayaan: "Ready hain. Bas approval pending hai."
Ankita: "Toh ready nahi hain."
Armaan: "Exactly. Main bhi isko wahi samjha raha tha."

Ayaan hansa.

Ayaan: "Waise aap aaj kaafi elegant lag rahi ho. Big presentation?"
Ankita: "Production release. Kisi ko impress karna hai toh application ko crash nahi hone dena."
Ayaan: "Aap har compliment ko task mein convert kar deti hain."
Ankita: "Habit hai."
Armaan: "Compliment ke saath completion report bhi bhejni padegi."
Ankita: "Smart boy."
Ayaan: "Mere saath unfair treatment ho raha hai."
Ankita: "Tumhara poster approve hone ke baad appeal sunungi."

Ground floor aaya. Ankita nikalte hue muskurayi.

Ayaan: "Have a great day, di!"
Ankita: "You too. Aur poster aaj hi bhejna."
Armaan (to Ayaan): "Dekha? Tum compliment se bachna chahte the. Ab deadline mil gayi."

parts.title: Sharmi's New Year Tease
parts.body:
Sharmi committee group par message type kar rahi thi.

Sharmi: "Oho! Madam Corporate Queen!"
Ankita: "Sharmi, good morning!"
Sharmi: "New Year hai ya annual award ceremony?"
Ankita: "Office jaana hai yaar."
Sharmi: "Itni taiyaari dekhkar Kabir bhi tumhe ghar se nikalne nahi dena chahta hoga."
Ankita: "Tum subah se shuru ho gayi?"
Sharmi: "Meri friend itni achhi lag rahi hai toh compliment bhi nahi kar sakti?"
Ankita: "Kar sakti ho. Lekin next line mein committee ka kaam mat dena."
Sharmi: "Too late. Sunday event registrations."
Ankita: "Mujhe pata tha!"
Sharmi: "Please ek sheet review kar dena."
Ankita: "Release green ho jaaye, phir bhejna."
Sharmi: "Aur Kabir ko bolna aaj dinner pe le jaaye."
Ankita: "Tum meri friend ho ya date planner?"
Sharmi: "Dono. Free service."

Ankita ne bye kaha aur gate ki taraf badh gayi.

parts.title: The Package She Hasn't Seen
parts.body:
Gate par watchman Gopal register entries kar raha tha.

Ankita: "Gopal ji, good morning."
Gopal: "Good morning, madam. Happy New Year."
Ankita: "Aaj meri ek courier aa sakti hai. Flat C-704."
Gopal: "Ji. Main receive kar lunga."
Ankita: "Please register mein entry kar dena. Aur kisi ko bina bataye hand over mat karna."
Gopal: "Bilkul, madam."
Ankita: "Main office mein rahungi. Confusion ho toh call kar lena."
Gopal: "Ji, koi problem nahi hogi."

Company cab aa gayi. Ankita ne Kabir ka breakfast joke padhkar muskurate hue car mein seat le li.

Gopal ne expected courier ka flat number note kiya. Us waqt usse apne future privacy breach ka koi andaaza nahi tha.

parts.title: A Release, a Joke, a Second Look
parts.body:
Cyber City office half-empty tha. New Year holiday hone ke bawajood deployment team apne desks par thi. Priya, QA Lead, ne Ankita ko dekhte hi screen ghumayi.

Priya: "Happy New Year. Aur sorry, first gift ek bug hai."
Ankita: "Happy New Year, Priya. Bug ka description?"
Priya: "Retry case mein mismatch."
Nisha (Junior Java Developer): "Spring service logs clean hain, lekin gateway timeout reproduce hua."
Ankita: "Perfect. Matlab hum release rush nahi karenge."

Vivan revised presentation lekar paas aaya.

Vivan: "Good morning, Ankita. Happy New Year."
Ankita: "Happy New Year. Tumhari slides ready?"
Vivan: "Slides ready hain. Lekin ek problem hai."
Ankita: "Ab kya?"
Vivan: "Aapne kaha tha tests pass hone ke baad compliments allowed honge."
Ankita: "Tumne ye baat abhi tak yaad rakhi?"
Vivan: "Important instructions bhoolta nahi."
Priya: "Kaash ye quality checklist ke saath bhi hota."

Sab hans pade.

Vivan: "Priya, tum meri reputation destroy kar rahi ho."
Ankita: "Nahi, woh evidence present kar rahi hai."
Vivan: "Okay. Toh evidence ke saath ek compliment."
Ankita: "Aaj kaun sa?"

Vivan ek pal ruka.

Vivan: "You look wonderful today. Aur usse bhi important, jab tum room mein aati ho na, sabko lagta hai problem solve ho jayegi."

Ankita ki smile thodi dheemi hui. Ye usual presentation joke se different tha.

Ankita: "That's actually sweet, Vivan. Thank you."
Vivan: "You're welcome."
Priya: "Ab emotional appreciation session khatam?"
Ankita: "Priya!"
Priya: "Kya? Mujhe regression run karna hai."
Vivan: "One more line, please."
Ankita: "Tumhara quota finish."
Vivan: "Quota increase request?"
Ankita: "Denied."
Vivan: "Appeal?"
Ankita: "With test evidence."

Reyansh workstation se uthkar aaya.

Reyansh: "Latency graph update ho gaya. Ankita, aap review kar lengi?"
Ankita: "Sure. Send it over."
Reyansh: "Aur... Happy New Year. Aaj ka presentation genuinely impressive hai."
Ankita: "Tum dono itni tareef kar rahe ho ki mujhe lag raha hai release mein koi hidden issue hai."
Reyansh: "Issue nahi. Observation."
Vivan: "Good line."
Reyansh: "Tumne sab achhi lines reserve kar rakhi hain kya?"
Ankita: "Gentlemen, please. Ab office mode."

Sab apne kaam par laut gaye. Ankita ko Vivan ka sentence yaad raha: jab tum room mein aati ho, sabko lagta hai problem solve ho jayegi. Aaj usne ek personal compliment ko turant dismiss nahi kiya.

parts.title: First Broken Seal
parts.body:
Courier delivery van gate par ruki.

Courier: "C-704, Ankita Malhotra. Security receive karegi?"
Gopal: "Haan. Register mein entry kar do."
Courier: "Package delicate hai. Handle carefully."
Gopal: "Theek hai."

Delivery ke baad Gopal ne box security desk par rakha. Packaging par private-delivery marking thi. Use seal protect karke Ankita ko inform karna chahiye tha; lekin curiosity mein usne box khol diya.

Andar personal clothing ke multiple sealed sets aur ek separately packed adult personal item tha. Gopal samajh gaya ki parcel private hai, phir bhi ek clothing set rakh liya.

Gopal (under his breath): "Ye kya kar diya maine..."

Usne box dobara band kiya, lekin seal properly nahi baithi. Ek personal purchase ko usne Ankita aur Kabir ki marriage ke baare mein apni unsupported kahani bana diya.

Reader-only consequence: first of six clothing sets is missing. This violation was neither authorized nor known to Ankita. Any separately planned private fantasy remains outside this prose draft, and the source parcel ledger is unchanged.

parts.title: The Chairman's Discovery
parts.body:
Gopal damaged parcel lekar Mahendra Suri (61), society chairman, ke paas gaya.

Gopal: "Sir, ek parcel ka seal loose hai. Address check karna tha."
Mahendra: "Kiska?"
Gopal: "C-704. Ankita madam ka."
Mahendra: "Tumne receive kiya tha?"
Gopal: "Ji."
Mahendra: "Toh logbook mein damaged condition mention karo."
Gopal: "Ji sir. Aap ek baar verify kar denge?"

Gopal nikal gaya. Mahendra ne packaging aur printed invoice dekha. Shipment clearly personal thi. Parcel protect karne ke bajay Mahendra ne contents inspect kiye aur ek clothing set apne paas rakh liya.

Mahendra society chairman ki authority ke peeche apni privacy violation chhupa raha tha. Use Gopal ke pehle removal ka pata nahi tha.

Reader-only consequence: second set missing. Ankita Cyber City mein hai; neither she nor Rajeev knows about this handoff.

parts.title: The Senior Consultant's Silence
parts.body:
Mr. Bhalla (58), senior client consultant, rollback readiness discuss kar rahe the.

Bhalla: "Ankita, fallback twice tested?"
Ankita: "Yes, sir. Both runs documented."
Bhalla: "Lekin retry behaviour?"
Reyansh: "Latest chart yahan hai."
Vivan: "And we have the verification notes."

Ankita ne comparison screen open kiya.

Ankita: "First test mein service recovered in the expected window. Second run mein gateway threshold adjust kiya. We will not deploy without sign-off."
Bhalla: "That's sensible. You seem prepared for every objection."
Ankita: "Sir, objections are cheaper than outages."
Bhalla: "Well said."

Meeting ke baad Vivan printed report lekar paas aaya.

Vivan: "He looked genuinely impressed."
Ankita: "He should be. Team worked hard."
Vivan: "Tum kabhi apna credit leti ho?"
Ankita: "Kabhi-kabhi."
Vivan: "Good. Because I wanted to say something."
Ankita: "Another compliment?"
Vivan: "Not exactly. Tum jab difficult question ka answer deti ho na, tumhari voice suddenly very calm ho jaati hai."
Ankita: "Woh training ka effect hai."
Vivan: "Maybe. I find it impressive."
Ankita: "Tum aaj observation mode mein ho?"
Vivan: "Perhaps."
Ankita: "Then observe this—next verification ka deadline eleven thirty."
Vivan: "There she is."

Ankita hansi.

Ankita: "Who?"
Vivan: "The person who can make even a compliment sound like a task assignment."
Ankita: "Aur tumhari habit hai har conversation ko thoda longer bana dena."
Vivan: "Is that a complaint?"
Ankita: "Observation."
Vivan: "Good recovery."

Dono ek pal muskuraaye. Meeting room ke bahar footsteps sunai diye.

Ankita: "Back to work."
Vivan: "Yes, boss."

Bhalla ne outwardly signed report maangi. Apni one-sided attraction unhone kisi ke saamne acknowledge nahi ki. Ankita ko uske baare mein knowledge nahi tha.

parts.title: Om's Private Detour
parts.body:
Om (63, Shivani ke ghar ka socially addressed elder, actual FIL nahi) visitor-log verification ke liye aaye.

Mahendra: "Om ji, ye Tower C ka register verify karna tha."
Om: "Koi mismatch?"
Mahendra: "Parcel address mein confusion hai."
Om: "Flat number toh clear hai."

Mahendra call ke liye desk se door gaye. Om ki nazar damaged parcel par padi. Private contents visible the. Om ne bhi ek clothing set bina permission rakh liya aur parcel counter par chhod diya.

Mahendra wapas aaye.

Om: "Address correct hai."
Mahendra: "Thank you."

Om ko pata nahi tha ki pehle do log sets remove kar chuke hain. Reader-only consequence: third set missing.

parts.title: Subhash and the Unasked Question
parts.body:
Subhash (59, Taniya ke household ka socially addressed elder, actual future FIL nahi) accounting papers submit karne aaye.

Subhash: "Mahendra ji? Register ka updated page yahan rakh raha hoon."

Koi jawab nahi aaya. Desk par damaged box pada tha. Subhash ne label padha, unauthorized contents inspect kiye aur ek clothing set rakh liya.

Helper: "Subhash ji, aapko chairman ne kuch kaha?"
Subhash: "Nahi. Bas documents dekar jaa raha tha."

Subhash nikal gaye. Unki Ankita ke baare mein personal assumptions ka koi factual basis nahi tha.

Reader-only consequence: fourth set missing, other men's removals unknown to Subhash.

parts.title: Mohan Notices the Seal
parts.body:
Mohan (64, Meenakshi ke ghar ka unrelated guest Uncle ji, actual FIL nahi) health-camp volunteer material check kar rahe the.

Mohan: "Ye medical supplies ka carton kidhar rakhen?"
Office helper: "Side table par, sir. Chairman ne list wahi rakhi hai."

Mohan ne list rakhte hue Ankita ke damaged parcel ka naam dekha. Usne pehle se khuli packaging inspect ki aur ek clothing set chhupa liya.

Office helper: "Sir, health-camp forms mil gaye?"
Mohan: "Haan. Yahin rakhe hain."

Mohan chal diye, samajhte hue ki unki action kisi ko pata nahi chali. Reader-only consequence: fifth set missing.

parts.title: The Last Unseen Removal
parts.body:
Arvind (65, Shreya ke ghar ka socially addressed Uncle ji, actual FIL nahi) maintenance notice lekar aaye.

Arvind: "Chairman ko ye notice dena hai."
Helper: "Sir meeting room mein hain. Desk par rakh dijiye."

Arvind ne notice rakha. Paas ka damaged parcel ab khula tha. Arvind ne last remaining clothing set rakh liya.

Arvind: "Notice un tak pahunch jayega na?"
Helper: "Ji, sir."

Arvind nikal gaye.

Ab original six clothing sets mein se ek bhi box mein nahi bacha tha. Gopal, Mahendra, Om, Subhash, Mohan aur Arvind—har ek ne apni action chhupayi; kisi ko complete chain nahi pata thi. Ankita absent aur unaware hai.

parts.title: The Coffee Nobody Owed
parts.body:
Deployment ka milestone verification pass ho gaya tha. Vivan coffee tray lekar pantry mein aaya. Priya aur Nisha pehle se thi.

Vivan: "Ladies, Happy New Year. Coffee meri taraf se."
Priya: "Kis khushi mein?"
Vivan: "Release survived."
Nisha: "Next run pending hai."
Vivan: "Tum log celebrations ko bhi regression testing bana doge."

Ankita andar aayi.

Ankita: "What's happening?"
Priya: "Vivan coffee se productivity buy kar raha hai."
Vivan: "Main team appreciation kar raha hoon."
Ankita: "Interesting strategy."

Vivan ne uske saamne cup rakha.

Vivan: "Less sugar. Right?"
Ankita: "Tumhe yaad hai?"
Vivan: "Obviously."
Ankita: "Obviously kyun?"
Vivan: "Because you complain when it's too sweet."
Priya: "Good. At least kisi ne documentation maintain ki."

Sab hans pade.

Nisha: "Main dashboard monitor kar leti hoon."
Priya: "Main bhi. Alert aaye toh celebration cancel."

Dono pantry se nikal gayin. Ab Ankita aur Vivan coffee counter ke paas the.

Ankita: "Tumne sabki coffee order yaad ki hai?"
Vivan: "Mostly."
Ankita: "Mostly?"
Vivan: "Tumhari definitely."

Ankita ne cup uthaya.

Ankita: "Vivan..."
Vivan: "Yes?"
Ankita: "Aaj tum unusually charming banne ki koshish kar rahe ho."
Vivan: "Koshish successful hai?"

Ankita ne jawab dene se pehle sip liya.

Ankita: "Coffee achhi hai."
Vivan: "That's not an answer."
Ankita: "It's the answer you're getting."

Vivan thoda serious hua.

Vivan: "Kabhi-kabhi lagta hai main tumse zyada casually baat kar leta hoon. If that's uncomfortable, tell me."
Ankita: "You do talk a lot."
Vivan: "Fair."
Ankita: "But uncomfortable? Not really."
Vivan: "Good."
Ankita: "Actually... tumhare jokes stressful meetings ko thoda easier bana dete hain."
Vivan: "That's probably the nicest thing you've said to me."
Ankita: "Don't get used to it."
Vivan: "Too late."

Kuch pal dono coffee ke saath khade rahe. Ankita chahti toh conversation wahi end kar sakti thi. Iske bajay usne khud ek aur question poocha.

Ankita: "Waise tumne New Year ka plan kya banaya?"
Vivan: "Office ke baad friends ke saath dinner. Tum?"
Ankita: "Kabir ke saath hopefully quiet evening."
Vivan: "Sounds nice."
Ankita: "It is."
Vivan: "He's lucky."
Ankita: "I'm lucky too."
Vivan: "I know."

Priya ki awaaz hallway se aayi.

Priya: "Ankita! Next report aa gaya!"
Ankita: "Coming!"

Darwaze tak pahunchkar Ankita palti.

Ankita: "Vivan?"
Vivan: "Hmm?"
Ankita: "Coffee genuinely perfect thi. Thank you."
Vivan: "Anytime."

Woh office floor ki taraf laut gayi. Vivan ka 'He's lucky' kehna use yaad raha. Usse bhi zyada ye ki Vivan ne poocha tha—conversation uncomfortable toh nahi. Ankita unhappy marriage mein nahi thi, par personal attention ko ab sirf office joke ki tarah dismiss bhi nahi kar rahi thi.

parts.title: Rajeev Receives the Remainder
parts.location: Community office and Rajeev's return route
parts.body:
Rajeev ko Mahendra ka phone aaya.

Mahendra: "Rajeev ji, Ankita ka courier community office mein reh gaya tha."
Rajeev: "Office mein? Security par rehna chahiye tha."
Mahendra: "Packaging damaged hai. Aap collect kar lenge?"
Rajeev: "Haan. Main aa raha hoon."

Rajeev office pahunchkar box dekhte hi ruk gaye.

Rajeev: "Ye kisne khola?"
Mahendra: "Mujhe bhi loose seal mein mila."
Rajeev: "Ankita ne toh clearly security ko receive karne ko kaha tha."
Mahendra: "Haan. Isliye aapse contact kiya."

Rajeev ne paperwork check kiya. Listed garments gayab the; separately packed personal item aur booklet baaki thi.

Rajeev: "Contents missing lag rahe hain."
Mahendra: "Mujhe complete list nahi pata."
Rajeev: "Phir ye office mein kyun rakha tha?"
Mahendra: "Address verification ka issue tha."
Rajeev: "Private courier mein address clear hai."

Mahendra ke paas satisfactory jawab nahi tha. Rajeev ne box liya.

Mahendra: "Rajeev ji... ek personal baat poochni thi."
Rajeev: "Kya?"
Mahendra: "Kabir aur Ankita... sab theek hain na?"
Rajeev: "Aap aisa kyun pooch rahe hain?"
Mahendra: "Nahi, bas concern."
Rajeev: "Mere bete aur bahu ki personal life par concern ki zarurat nahi. Parcel kisne handle kiya, woh bataiye."

Rajeev damaged parcel lekar ghar ki taraf chal diye. Unke andar apne inappropriate thoughts aur family responsibility ka contradiction tha, lekin missing contents ka sawaal bhi sach tha.

parts.title: Six Men, Six Different Secrets
parts.body:
Veranda mein Mahendra, Om, Subhash, Mohan, Arvind aur Rajeev routine New Year discussion ke liye baithe.

Mahendra: "Health camp aur visitor register ko streamline karna hai."
Mohan: "Medical volunteer list ready hai."
Arvind: "Maintenance notice bhi submit kar diya."
Om: "Tower C ke parcel register mein correction chahiye."

Rajeev ne turant upar dekha.

Rajeev: "Exactly. Private packages ko unnecessary handle nahi karna chahiye."
Subhash: "Koi specific incident hua?"
Rajeev: "Hua hai. Ankita ka parcel damaged mila."

Table par khamoshi.

Om: "Damaged kaise?"
Rajeev: "Wahi toh pata karna hai."
Mahendra: "Main security se check karwaunga."
Rajeev: "Please. Aur handling log bhi chahiye."
Mohan: "Health-camp coordination ke liye bhi visitor entries important hain."
Rajeev: "Bilkul. Lekin privacy bhi important hai."

Subhash ne dheere se poocha.

Subhash: "Rajeev ji, ek personal question poochun? Kabir aur Ankita khush hain na?"
Rajeev: "Haan. Bilkul. Aap ye question kyun pooch rahe hain?"
Subhash: "Nahi, bas..."
Rajeev: "Bas kya?"
Om: "Arre, personal baat hai. Rehne dijiye."

Rajeev ne table par pen rakh diya.

Rajeev: "Meri bahu ke parcel se meri family ke baare mein conclusions mat nikaliye."

Mahendra ne sir hilaya.

Mahendra: "You're right."

Lekin unke agree karne se kuch solve nahi hua. Multiple elders apne unauthorized actions chhupa rahe the. Kisi ko doosre ke secret ka complete knowledge nahi tha. Rajeev ko bhi missing contents ka sach pata nahi chala.

Meeting 12:50 par khatam hui.

parts.title: The First Crack
parts.body:
Ankita apne desk par status report read kar rahi thi.

Priya: "Looks good. Just one pending review."
Ankita: "Okay. Uska sign-off lunch ke baad."
Nisha: "Main notes update kar deti hoon."
Ankita: "Thanks, Nisha."

Vivan paas se guzra.

Vivan: "Ankita, coffee review final?"
Ankita: "Approved. Five stars."
Vivan: "Excellent. I'll add that to my performance appraisal."
Ankita: "Please don't."
Vivan: "Too late. It's documented."
Ankita: "Tum impossible ho."
Vivan: "But entertaining?"

Ankita ne screen se nazar uthayi.

Ankita: "Occasionally."
Vivan: "I'll take it."

Woh Reyansh ke desk ki taraf chal diya. Ankita ka phone vibrate hua—Kabir ka message tha.

Kabir (message): "Breakfast chef requesting final New Year rating."
Ankita (reply): "Chef approved. Dinner performance pending."

Woh hansi, phone rakh diya. Kuch der baad uski nazar Vivan par gayi, jo Reyansh ke saath technical issue discuss kar raha tha. Ankita ne ek pal use dekha, phir monitor par laut aayi.

Woh apne husband se pyaar karti thi aur marriage ko lekar koi doubt nahi tha. Lekin aaj Vivan ki personal attention uske mann mein jagah bana chuki thi.

Ankita (thought): "Ek coffee se kuch nahi badalta."

Aur isi thought ke saath usne Vivan ki taraf dobara dekhne ki ichchha roki.

01:00 PM — Ankita Cyber City office mein hi thi. Society mein parcel ke saath jo hua, uski usse koi khabar nahi thi.
